sources.title: Toxic Comment Classification using Deep Learning
sources.snippet: Overview A multilingual toxic comment classification system that can identify toxic content across 7 languages (English, Russian, Turkish, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese). The system uses language-aware transformers with custom attention mechanisms and advanced deep learning techniques to accurately classify comments into different toxicity categories.

sources.title: Gowry11/multilingual-toxic-comment-classification - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project fine-tunes the XLM-RoBERTa model for multilingual toxic comment classification using the Hugging Face Multilingual Toxicity Dataset. The objective is to automatically identify toxic and non-toxic comments across multiple languages using a state-of-the-art transformer-based deep learning model.
